Home/Privacy Policy

Privacy Policy

At Sofilx LOTO, we care about the security of your personal data. This page explains what information is processed when you use our website.

Information collected

Our site has no membership or online payment. The contact and quote forms do not save the information you enter on our server; your details are sent to us only through your email application or WhatsApp, which opens with your approval.

Quote cart

Products you add to the quote cart are kept only in your own browser (local storage) and are not sent to us until you submit them.

Use of information

The contact details you send us are used only to respond to your request, prepare a quote and for after-sales communication; they are not shared with third parties.

Your rights

For requests under Law No. 6698 on the Protection of Personal Data (KVKK), you can write to info@sofilxloto.com.

Since 2010 we have been supplying industrial facilities with LOTO lockout and tagout equipment. Our products comply with the requirements of OSHA 29 CFR 1910.147.
